description.narrow: Ipoh — основной городской и железнодорожный узел центрального Perak для радиальных выездов к Batu Gajah, Kuala Kangsar и Lenggong; не используется как координата этих объектов.

migration.note: Real locality created from researched source data; legacy composite route hubs are retained separately for compatibility.

geography: Ipoh sits in Kinta Valley between the Kledang Range to the west and Titiwangsa Range to the east.

geology.summary: Official NRES material describes Ipoh as broadly underlain by Kinta Formation limestone, with isolated mogote-style limestone hills; the wider Kinta Valley also carries granite, alluvial and former tin-mining landscapes.

transport.rail: ETS/KTMB связывает Ipoh с основным коридором полуострова.

safety.caveat: Police district is not necessarily the same as the administrative district; unreported crimes are absent. These are absolute counts, not a population-normalized rate and not a safety score.

provenance.note: Gateway-only profile; local city reference remains in research queue.
